entries.title: Identifying indicators of consciousness in AI systems
entries.lesson: Canonical theory-derived 14-indicator framework; no indicator known necessary nor any combination sufficient

entries.title: Consciousness in Artificial Intelligence: Insights from the Science of Consciousness
Tests for consciousness in humans and beyond
entries.lesson: Validation of consciousness tests is an unsolved challenge beyond benchmark humans

entries.title: Adversarial testing of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theories of consciousness
entries.lesson: Preregistered divergent predictions; challenges central tenets of both GNWT and IIT; no winner

entries.title: A beautiful loop: An active inference theory of consciousness
entries.lesson: Global precision meta-forecasting theory; minimal awareness need not require explicit self-modeling

entries.title: Design and evaluation of a global workspace agent embodied in a realistic multimodal environment
entries.lesson: Embodied global workspace architecture already exists: direct implementation prior art

entries.title: Causal evidence that language models use confidence to drive behaviour
entries.lesson: Causal link from confidence representations to abstention: confidence-guided behavior not novel

entries.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
entries.lesson: Injected internal concepts can sometimes be detected; reported introspection fragile and context dependent

entries.title: Interventional Training Reduces Causal Bypass in In-Context Introspection
entries.lesson: Interventional training and causal bypass in introspection studied: explicit near prior art

entries.title: Sentient AI in robots and agents: prolegomena for an evidence-based research program
entries.lesson: Multi-theory indicator assessment, causal sensorimotor lesions, self-location and anti-anthropomorphism controls already proposed

entries.title: Calibration and transfer in indicator-based assessments of artificial consciousness
entries.lesson: No independently validated artificial phenomenal-consciousness ground truth; biological transfer assumptions not established

entries.title: Three reasons why AI is not conscious and perhaps never will be
entries.lesson: Skeptical critique: intelligence versus experience, functionalism and digital physical substrate

entries.title: AI and Consciousness: A Skeptical Overview
entries.lesson: Philosophical examination of uncertainty; no consensus that apparently humanlike AI is conscious

entries.title: Can we assess consciousness in AI?
entries.lesson: Questions computational functionalism and adequacy of transferring neurobiological indicators

entries.title: From the mechanics of consciousness to the consciousness of machines: Seven approaches
entries.lesson: Different definitions and approaches imply incompatible machine-consciousness experimental priorities

entries.title: Evolving reservoir computers reveal bidirectional coupling between predictive power and emergent dynamics
entries.lesson: Reservoir predictive capacity emergence studied; basic prediction/emergence not novel

entries.title: Artificial intelligence and consciousness
entries.lesson: Separates phenomenal/access/self consciousness and examines robots vs LLMs

entries.title: Can We Test Consciousness Theories on AI? Ablations, Markers, and Robustness
entries.status: preprint arXiv, not independently verified as peer reviewed
entries.lesson: Synthetic HOT self-model lesion preserves first-order task while collapsing metacognitive calibration; GWT workspace lesions, broadcast fragility, PCI-A negative control. Direct near-duplicate of simple C1/C2 demonstrations.

entries.authors: Butlin, Bayne, Fleming, Mudrik, Peters, Schwitzgebel, Simon, VanRullen
entries.title: Consciousness indicators, mimicry, and internal variants
entries.lesson: Indicator mimicry and implementation variance are live concerns; simply building functional analogues cannot settle phenomenal consciousness.
